title: Desk Guidance: Primary Care Referrals and Prior Authorization Review-Time Extensions
content:
**Rule applied at the desk.** The referral cut of a member-requested deadline extension looks at the referrals the member's primary care provider issued in the two months before the day of the request: where a standing referral was issued, two days are cut; where only a single referral was issued, one day is cut; where none was issued, nothing is cut.

The referrals are the referral issue entries on the member's Primary Care Provider Assignment, each marked as a standing or a single referral. The days are subtracted once from the days a member-requested deadline extension adds, before the limits of one day and of the class's most review-extension days are applied. The rule belongs to Prior Authorization review time.

| Referrals issued in the two months before the request | Days cut |
|---|---|
| at least one standing referral | 2 |
| single referrals only | 1 |
| none | 0 |

## Points of judgement

- A standing referral in the window gives a cut of 2 days whether or not single referrals were also issued.
- Several single referrals still give a cut of 1 day.
- *Hypothetical:* a referral issued three months before the request day is outside the window; if it is the only referral, nothing is cut.
